facts.fact: Madagascar's Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT) is stated to exist and operate, with a Director General, Eric Rakotomaniraka, speaking for it at the inaugural Cybersecurity Symposium in Antananarivo on 22-23 June 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Development, Posts and Telecommunications

note: Critical-infrastructure (OIV) criteria are only forthcoming in the new legislation, so no cii fact; no incident, alert or figures stated.
